title: 🆕 New Pair: 0x928661e51934D54576... on bsc
summary:
SpyChain is an Arbitrum Orbit L2 settled on BNB Smart Chain, built for onchain stock markets.

$SPYB is the native gas asset of the network. Transfers, swaps, contract calls and applications on SpyChain all use SPYB for gas.

$SPYC is the protocol token used across market bonds, protocol liquidity, governance and ecosystem incentives.

The first major piece of the liquidity layer is SPY5.

SPY5 focuses on the five largest supported SPY constituents available onchain. Protocol liquidity is directed toward markets around those assets, giving SpyChain a core set of stock markets instead of leaving liquidity fragmented across unrelated pools.

As those markets grow, $SPYC acts as the protocol asset coordinating liquidity around SPYB and the supported stock ecosystem.

SpyChain will also include:

SPY Markets — infrastructure for stock and ETF-paired markets.

SPY Router — routing across supported assets and liquidity.

SPY Terminal — the main interface for trading, liquidity, market data and network activity.

SPYB powers the network.

$SPYC coordinates the economy built on top of it.
